name: Chandrakala Ras

sections.overview: Chandrakala Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Chandrakala Ras is an herbal formulation in the form of a tablet. It consists of herbal and mineral components, so, it should be strictly used under medical supervision. It is used in treating diabetes and the complications it causes like neuropathy.
sections.ingredients:
Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum) 
 Camphor (Cinnamomum camphora) 
 Amla (Emblica officinalis) 
 Nutmeg (Myristica fragrans) 
 Silk cotton tree (Bombax malabaricum) 
 Purified and processed mercury 
 Tin Bhasma 
 Iron Bhasma 
 Tinospora (Tinospora cordifolia) 
 Honey 

 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and crush all the ingredients to a fine powder except Tinospora cordifolia. Make a decoction of Tinospora and Bombax malabaricum mixed with honey. Triturate the powders in this concoction and make pills from it.
sections.dosage: 1 – 2 tablets after meals twice daily with Cow Milk.
sections.indications:
Hematuria 
 Hemoptysis 
 Dysuria 
 Hemorrhages 
 Menorrhagia 
 Leucorrhea 
 Burning sensation on palms and soles 
 Burning sensation during micturition
sections.contraindications:
Over dosage might alter control of blood sugar levels. 
 This medicine should only be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 Avoid consumption of this medicine during pregnancy. 
 Self-medication is not encouraged. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Chandrakala Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Introduction 
 Chandrakala Ras is an herbal formulation in the form of a tablet. It consists of herbal and mineral components, so, it should be strictly used under medical supervision. It is used in treating diabetes and the complications it causes like neuropathy. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum) 
 Camphor (Cinnamomum camphora) 
 Amla (Emblica officinalis) 
 Nutmeg (Myristica fragrans) 
 Silk cotton tree (Bombax malabaricum) 
 Purified and processed mercury 
 Tin Bhasma 
 Iron Bhasma 
 Tinospora (Tinospora cordifolia) 
 Honey 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and crush all the ingredients to a fine powder except Tinospora cordifolia. Make a decoction of Tinospora and Bombax malabaricum mixed with honey. Triturate the powders in this concoction and make pills from it. 
 Dosage 
 1 – 2 tablets after meals twice daily with Cow Milk. 
 Indications 
 
 Hematuria 
 Hemoptysis 
 Dysuria 
 Hemorrhages 
 Menorrhagia 
 Leucorrhea 
 Burning sensation on palms and soles 
 Burning sensation during micturition 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage might alter control of blood sugar levels. 
 This medicine should only be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 Avoid consumption of this medicine during pregnancy. 
 Self-medication is not encouraged. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
